title: vfx performance level (version 1)
description: data/vfx/perf.json: the Performance level's caps on the debris pool (docs/vfx/perf-level.md). Presentation only: read by render/vfx/perf.gd and debris.gd, never by the sim, and used only while the hub's perf_level switch is on. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore.

cap.description: The pool's cap at the Performance level (460 otherwise).

spill_cap.description: Bits a burst's overflow may queue; 0 drops them as before.

spill_wait_ticks.description: A queued bit that has waited this many ticks is dropped.

debris.description: The pool's cap, the per-tick budgets, and the batching of a burst's overflow.

per_tick.description: Timed jobs of the pool run in one tick; the rest run on the next.

far.description: A spawn farther than reach_k half-views plus margin (units) from both fighters is not made, nor dust more than puff_z_back behind the fighter plane.
